help.helpContent003: Use the available Google, email and password, or email-code option on the sign-in screen. Verify your email when asked, then complete your profile.
help.helpContent004: Can I use the app without a vehicle?
help.helpContent005: Yes. Add one later from Garage, or sign in with the verified email an Owner used to grant you access.
help.helpContent006: How do I add a vehicle?
help.helpContent007: Open More → Garage → Add vehicle. Choose its category and details, energy type, meter mode and time zone, then save.
help.helpContent008: What if my vehicle has no registration yet?
help.helpContent009: Provide a vehicle name or model instead. Registration is optional when another identifying detail is supplied.
help.helpContent011: Use the vehicle switcher when more than one active vehicle is available. Entries and reports apply to the selected vehicle.
help.helpContent012: What do KM, HOURS and BOTH mean?
help.helpContent013: Choose KM for distance, HOURS for engine use, or BOTH if you record both. Readings are optional on fuel and expense entries.
help.helpContent015: How do I add fuel or charging?
help.helpContent016: Open Fuel and add an entry. Check the vehicle, date, energy type and unit; enter any two of quantity, unit price and amount, then review and save.
help.helpContent017: What is a full or partial fill?
help.helpContent018: Mark a fill as full only when the tank was actually filled. Partial quantities between two qualifying full fills contribute to the full-to-full calculation.
help.helpContent019: Can I save fuel without a meter reading?
help.helpContent020: Yes. Save the entry without KM or HOURS. A missing or incorrectly timed reading can prevent an efficiency interval from qualifying.
help.helpContent021: Can I add a reading later?
help.helpContent022: Yes. Record the actual observed time. Only associate a reading with the original fill time if you truly observed it then; do not guess or backdate it.
help.helpContent024: It needs qualifying full-to-full fills with compatible fuel units and matching, truthful meter readings. Missing readings, resets or inconsistent history can make an interval unavailable.
help.helpContent025: What does the efficiency average mean?
help.helpContent026: Insights uses total distance divided by fuel, or fuel divided by engine hours, across qualifying intervals. An interval is shown under its closing fill date; it is not a measurement for each intervening day.
help.helpContent028: How do I add an expense?
help.helpContent029: Open Expenses → Add, check the vehicle, choose a category, enter the amount and date, and save. Add a title, vendor, payment method or notes as needed.
help.helpContent030: Should fuel also be entered as an expense?
help.helpContent031: Record fuel in Fuel. Entering the same purchase as an expense too would count it twice in reports.
help.helpContent033: Enter available principal and interest details. Reports distinguish operating cost, financing and unclassified amounts from cash outflow.
help.helpContent034: Can I save an expense without KM or HOURS?
help.helpContent035: Yes. Both are optional. Record a reading only when it was actually observed and give its correct observation time.
help.helpContent036: How do I add a separate meter reading?
help.helpContent037: Open More → Add meter reading, choose the vehicle and meter type, enter the observed value and time, then save.
help.helpContent039: A reading must fit the surrounding active readings for that meter and vehicle. Check its value and observed time; use the correction or reset workflow when appropriate.
help.helpContent041: How do I share a vehicle?
help.helpContent042: An Owner opens the vehicle’s members screen, enters the person’s email, selects Owner or Pilot, reviews permissions and grants access.
help.helpContent043: Does the recipient accept an invitation?
help.helpContent044: No acceptance step is needed. Access resolves after the person signs in with the granted verified email; an existing verified account can receive access immediately.
help.helpContent046: Owners manage the vehicle, members and available permissions, and can work with its records and reports. The protected primary administrator has additional safeguards.
help.helpContent048: A Pilot can view or add fuel, expenses and meter readings when permitted. Access is per vehicle and may be restricted by the Owner; Pilot history is limited to today and yesterday in the vehicle time zone.
help.helpContent049: Can a Pilot edit or delete entries?
help.helpContent050: The current Pilot policy does not allow editing or deleting Pilot records. Ask an Owner to review a correction or deletion.
help.helpContent051: Can the same person have different roles?
help.helpContent052: Yes. A person can be an Owner on one vehicle and a Pilot on another. Each vehicle has its own access settings.
help.helpContent053: How do I change or remove access?
help.helpContent054: An Owner opens Members for that vehicle and edits or revokes the member or outstanding grant. Protected administrator rules may prevent certain changes.
help.helpContent055: Why can’t a shared vehicle be seen?
help.helpContent056: Confirm the email was verified, the grant is active, and the right account is signed in. Ask the Owner to check the member and permission settings.
help.helpContent058: How do I record a document?
help.helpContent059: Open More → Document details, enter the document title and details, then save.
help.helpContent061: No. Entries are reminders and personal records, not legal RC or licence documents. Use the relevant official source for proof.
help.helpContent062: How do I create a reminder?
help.helpContent063: Open More → Reminders and add one. Enter a title and at least a due date, KM threshold or HOURS threshold, choose recurrence if needed, and save.
help.helpContent064: What can reminders be used for?
help.helpContent065: Use them for service, insurance, EMI, permits or other vehicle tasks. Set a date or a real meter threshold that suits the task.
help.helpContent066: Can a document or expense create a reminder?
help.helpContent067: Eligible document expiry and EMI expense forms offer linked reminders. Maintenance details can also carry a next service date or meter threshold.
help.helpContent069: For a dated reminder choose monthly or yearly recurrence. Completing it advances its date; check the next date and meter thresholds after completion.
help.helpContent071: Enable notifications in Settings and Android settings. Date alerts are local to the device and subject to system limits. Meter alerts depend on recorded readings and app reconciliation; GPS is not used.
help.helpContent072: Can I complete or snooze a reminder?
help.helpContent073: Open the reminder details and use Complete or Snooze when you have permission. A recurring dated reminder advances when completed.
help.helpContent075: What is the difference between Insights and Reports?
help.helpContent076: Insights visualizes accessible spending, efficiency and measured intervals. Reports provides a period summary and JSON, CSV and PDF export.
help.helpContent077: What is included in an export?
help.helpContent078: The selected period’s accessible records, meter observations, completed intervals and summary. Intervals may start before the selected period. CSV has filterable fields; JSON retains structured data.
help.helpContent079: Who can see my vehicle data?
help.helpContent080: Access is per vehicle and controlled by roles, permissions and server policies. Share only with trusted people; someone who exports data can keep a copy.
help.helpContent081: Does the app need an internet connection?
help.helpContent082: Yes. Loading and saving records requires a connection. Unsaved form changes remain only while the form stays open; they are not a durable offline draft.
help.helpContent083: How do I change the appearance?
help.helpContent084: Open Settings → Appearance and choose System default, Light or Dark. System default follows your device appearance.
help.helpContent085: How do I change my password?
help.helpContent086: Open Settings → Security and data and use Reset password. Follow the email flow for your account.
help.helpContent087: What happens when I sign out?
help.helpContent088: Your session and current unsaved changes are cleared on this device, and scheduled local notifications are cleared. Signing out does not delete your server records.
help.helpContent089: How do I request account deletion?
help.helpContent090: Open Settings → Request account deletion. Review the consequences and archive vehicles you administer as primary administrator first. The request revokes access; completion requires operator review.
help.helpContent091: What if saving or loading fails?
help.helpContent092: Check your connection and permissions. Keep an unsaved form open and retry. For access problems, ask the vehicle Owner to check your grant.
help.helpContent093: Where can I ask for privacy or deletion help?
help.helpContent094: Open Privacy and terms or Security and data for the operator contact. Include enough detail for the operator to identify the issue, but never send passwords or verification codes.
help.helpDescription: Practical answers for recording and sharing vehicle information. Available actions depend on your vehicle role and permissions.
